description: Google Sheets API - Create spreadsheets, write/read data, format cells, analyze data

tools.name: google_sheets_create
tools.description: 🌟 Create a new Google Sheet with optional data and headers. Auto-formats header row (gray background, bold text). Returns shareable link.

returns.description: Created spreadsheet with ID, shareable URL, title, and rows written

tools.name: google_sheets_append_data
tools.description: Append data to existing Google Sheet. Automatically finds last row and appends below existing data.

spreadsheet_id.description: Target spreadsheet ID (from URL or create response)

data.description: 2D array of data to append (e.g., [['Widget C', 39.99, 75]])

tools.name: google_sheets_read_data
tools.description: Read data from Google Sheet. Returns 2D array of values.

range_name.description: A1 notation range (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or 'Sheet1!A1:Z1000'). Default reads first 1000 rows.

returns.description: 2D array of values with row/column counts
